description.value:
You seize a collection of loose objects with the Force and set them spinning around you as animate combatants. Choose up to ten unattended, unenhanced objects within range, where a Medium object counts as two, a Large object as four, and a Huge object as eight (nothing larger than Huge can be affected). Each object rises and hovers near you, staying within 100 feet for the duration, acting as a construct with AC, hit points, and attacks scaled to its size, and flying at 30 feet.

As a bonus action, you can direct any or all of the animated objects at once, choosing their actions and destinations; they act at the end of your turn. An object ordered to attack makes one slam attack against a creature within 5 feet of it, with an attack bonus and kinetic damage keyed to its size: Tiny (+6 to hit, 1d4+3), Small (+6 to hit, 1d8+2), Medium (+5 to hit, 2d6+1), Large (+6 to hit, 2d10+2), or Huge (+8 to hit, 2d12+4).

Cast with a slot of 6th level or higher, you can animate two additional objects per slot level beyond 5th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 5
